text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Tuesday:
- Switzerland is sending 20 people to Albania to closely watch the country's election process and ensure that all is done legally.
- Cement consumption in Switzerland fell by 10 percent in 1996 to 3.9 million tonnes.
- Mettler Toledo is acquiring the British metal detector manufacturer Safeline, in order to expand its industrial quality control sector.
- ABN Amro Bank N.V., Amsterdam opens more offices in Zurich.
- A total of 10,685 applications for building permits were filed in Switzerland by the end of May.
- Shares in the Telecom PTT should be traded at the stock exchange starting the second half of 1998.
- Swiss Bank Corp is launching two new ecological investment products.
- France's new prime minister is Lionel Jospin. He has not yet reached a decision on whether to bring Communists into the government.
